lines.zh: 只是，即使越过了血肉的边界，也到不了永恒。
lines.en: Yet even past the bounds of flesh, there is no reaching eternity.
Silicon and metal break down too;

lines.zh: 思想需要物质承载，文明需要能量维系。
lines.en: thought needs matter to carry it, and a civilization needs energy to sustain it.

lines.zh: 当岁月走向百万亿年，最后的恒星也将陆续耗尽燃料。
lines.en: As the ages run toward a hundred trillion years, the last stars too will burn through their fuel, one after another.

lines.zh: 群星一盏盏熄灭，远征却仍未结束。
lines.en: The stars go out one by one, and yet the voyage is not over.

lines.zh: 那些在星际辗转的心智，也许会在黑洞附近栖居：
lines.en: The minds that wander between the stars may come to dwell near black holes:

lines.zh: 坠落的物质被撕扯、加热，释放出光芒，
lines.en: infalling matter, torn apart and heated, gives off light,

lines.zh: 照亮一座座悬在深渊边上的城市；
lines.en: lighting cities that hang at the edge of the abyss;

lines.zh: 黑洞尚未止息的自旋，像一根缓缓松开的发条，为思想与记忆供能。
lines.en: and the black hole's unspent spin, like a slowly unwinding spring, powers thought and memory.

lines.zh: 然而，可供吸积的物质会越来越少，
lines.en: But less and less matter will be left to fall in,
and the spring, too, will one day wind down.
